_comment: Scope-detection config for the Data Quality Gate (distinct from data-standards' .data-standards.json). Read by .claude/skills/data-quality-gate/scripts/scope_detect.py, stdlib-only, no PyYAML/psycopg needed for this step so an irrelevant PR returns NOT_APPLICABLE cheaply and fast.
_migration_command_note: dashboard/database/migrations/ is NOT self-sufficient — it's a set of incremental deltas layered on top of the base schema in infrastructure/supabase/00_complete-schema.sql (confirmed live: applying migrations/ alone to an empty throwaway Postgres fails immediately with 'relation "conversations" does not exist', since that table — and most of the core schema — is only defined in 00_complete-schema.sql, never inside migrations/ itself). migration_command therefore applies the real base schema first, RLS policies second, then every incremental migration in filename order.
migration_command: for f in infrastructure/supabase/00_complete-schema.sql infrastructure/supabase/01_rls-policies.sql; do psql "$DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f "$f" || exit 1; done; for f in dashboard/database/migrations/*.sql; do psql "$DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f "$f" || exit 1; done
